testimonials.name: Gustav Victor
testimonials.quote: Gustav's work here is genuinely game-changing — my grandfather's mantel clock hasn't lost a second, and honestly, it's not just repair, it's a philosophy. Absolutely worth stating plainly: the details matter.

testimonials.name: Elfriede Brandt
testimonials.quote: I shipped my cuckoo clock expecting the worst; in practice, it came back ticking like it was 1972 again. Truly seamless — and the wrapping was a delight, too.

testimonials.name: Mats Ohlsson
testimonials.quote: Fast, flexible, and reliable — three words I don't use lightly. The follow-up letter alone unlocked a small joy in my week.

faq.q: Is there a free first assessment?
faq.a: Yes! Send a photo of your clock and a short description — no charge, no obligation, and no gimmicks.

faq.q: Do you work on quartz clocks or only mechanical?
faq.a: Both — mechanical, quartz, and everything in between. The trap is assuming one size fits all; it never does.

faq.q: How long does a typical repair take?
faq.a: Most jobs return within two to three weeks — complicated rebuilds can take longer, and we'll always tell you up front.

faq.q: Do you offer support after the repair?
faq.a: Support exists in theory; in practice, we answer in minutes. Write any time — we'll walk you through it.
Absolutely — every clock is packed with care and tracked the whole way. Not a feature. A promise.
